propositions: The direct Anthropic fallback arms for frontier and standard model classes are approved and tested but not yet enabled in rebar.toml configuration

Configuring a fallback chain triggers whole-chain capability intersection that silently downgrades the primary model from native to prompted structured output, preventing use of the resilience feature without capability regression
Live testing confirmed that direct Anthropic Sonnet supports native structured output and thinking mode, resolving the prior asymmetry between Bedrock and direct Anthropic Sonnet capability records

The existing conservative capability-intersection mechanism is intentional by prior design but the approved redesign requires per-attempt capability resolution against the model actually being called, not pre-flight intersection
Mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains must disable prompt caching because provider-specific cache styles differ and conservatively intersect to none
